chapter_seo_title: Han Li Reunites with Mo Caihuan in Yanling Fort — A Mortal's Journey Chapter 252
chapter_meta_description: Han Li runs into an old friend on the streets of Yanling Fort, only to learn that the Mo family has been completely destroyed. A poignant reunion with dark undertones.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey — Chapter 252: A Reunion With the Past
og_description: A chance encounter on a Yanling Fort street brings Han Li face to face with Mo Caihuan—and a dark tale of the Mo family's ruin.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 252 — Han Li Meets an Old Friend
twitter_description: A single street collision in Yanling Fort reveals the Mo family's tragic fall. Han Li's past catches up with him.

lore_anchors.definition: A hidden fortress stronghold of the Yan Clan, protected by a concealment formation; mortals born here can never leave.
The martial organization once led by the Mo family; it was dissolved seven years ago following the Mo residence's destruction.
A fragrant pill associated with imperial concubines, known for its long-lasting aroma and mosquito-repelling effects; Han Li gifted this to Mo Caihuan years ago.
The surviving matriarch of the Mo family; she fled the destruction seven years ago and is now gravely ill in Yanling Fort.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li leave Dong Xuan’er so abruptly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He didn’t want to be burdened by her reputation or her scheming. Moving alone gave him more freedom to gather information and avoid being dragged into political trouble.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happened to the Mo family?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Mo residence was destroyed seven years ago, and the Jingjiao Society was dissolved. Two of Mo Caihuan’s stepmothers died in the attack. Only Mo Caihuan and her mother, Yan Shi, are confirmed to have survived.
No. Mortals who enter Yanling Fort are forbidden from leaving for life, on pain of immediate execution. The fort is a beautiful prison—safe, but inescapable.
